key_insight: Solvent-driven vitrimer disintegration begins below the critical dissolution temperature and yields smaller network fragments rather than isolated polymer chains.
engineering_relevance: Understanding how temperature and crosslink concentration govern fragmentation could guide solvent-assisted vitrimer recycling.
method: Analysis of network connectivity and dynamic bond redistribution
evidence_signal: Simulations show that the critical dissolution temperature rises nonlinearly with crosslink concentration, while intrachain dynamic bonds increase with temperature.
watch_item: The abstract reports simulation results; experimental validation is needed before translating these trends into recycling conditions.
paper_title: Solvent-Mediated Disintegration of a Vitrimer Network
